name: Chimneysweep
ability: Each night, choose a player. Learn a minion and demon they aren’t.

name: Confessor
ability: Each night, learn if you are droisoned. If someone is "mad" they are the confessor and aren't they might die

name: Trapper
ability: Once per game, publicly state a character today, until dawn, if they are killed, the killer dies instead.

name: Pidgeonkeeper
ability: If you die via execution, tonight, wake to learn how many evil players voted for and nominated you.

name: Sleuth
ability: 2nd night, learn 3 players that have a phrase in common. Each night*, guess what it is & learn how close you are.
otherNightReminder: If it's the second night. Show the 3 players. Let them guess

name: Blabbermouth
ability: 1st night, choose a player. Once per game, at night*: Make it so you and the evil team learn that player & character.
otherNightReminder: If the blabbermouth wants to use their ability, they learn the *Will Reveal* player. Then, the evil team learns the *will reveal* player.

jinxes.reason: marionette doesn't wake up for the Blabbermouth's ability

name: Qutler
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too

jinxes.reason: If the Cannibal gains the Qutler ability, the Cannibal learns this.
If the Organ Grinder is causing eyes closed voting, the Qutler may raise their hand to vote but their vote is only counted if their master voted too.

name: Sisyphus
ability: You have a task that might change, even if dead, if failed a player of your alignment is drunk until dusk.

name: Jinx
ability: When you die someone that would wake up at night doesn't

name: Records Kepper
ability: When you die, the Demon may choose up to 3 players to learn their character & reminders.

name: Time eater
ability: Each night*, if no one died throughout the whole day, choose a player: they die and it's announced that you're in game.
otherNightReminder: If nobody died throughout this last day, the time eater kills a player and it's annouced that they are in play.

name: Lieutennant
ability: Each day, visit the storyteller with help on how to sell a bluff. If you are executed, your nominator becomes evil tonight.

name: Soul eater
ability: If you publicly claim to be the Soul eater when nominated & nobody uses a ghost vote: the nominator is executed.

jinxes.reason: The cerenovus may choose to make a player mad that they are the Soul eater.

name: Exiled
ability: The first time either you or an Outsider dies, choose a player: they become a not in play outsider [-1 Outsider]
otherNightReminder: The first time either you or an Outsider dies: choose an player

name: Conductor
ability: Each night*, choose 3 players (all learn who): the 1st (good or demon) chooses to die or kill the other two.

name: Cassino
ability: Each night* choose a player, they die. A minion is poisoned & you start knowing all outsider players [+2 outsiders]

name: Ozymandias
ability: Each night* choose a player: they die. Then learn the storyteller's opinion of best/worst kill tonight, alternating.
otherNightReminder: Ozymandias chooses a player, then tell them who you think is the best player to kill

name: MAAT
ability: MAAT's Buddy registers as MAAT. That's the joke!
otherNightReminder: Remember that you are doing a great job as a storyteller

name: Murder
ability: You can kill people if you feel like it, this won't affect the game. The storyteller may remove this.
